content: NativeWind v4.2.6 is stable (v5 pre-release, maintenance questioned as of Sept 2026). Requires tailwindcss ^3.4.17 (v4 unsupported, peer >3.3.0). Babel needs babel-preset-expo with jsxImportSource:nativewind plus nativewind/babel preset; metro needs withNativeWind(config,{input:'./global.css'}). Dark-only: set userInterfaceStyle dark in app config or colorScheme.set('dark'); Expo only follows system appearance if userInterfaceStyle is automatic. React Compiler: Expo SDK 54+ auto-configures babel; node_modules excluded from compilation; NativeWind issue #1812 dev-warning crash involves React Compiler env. v5 has silent class drops (text-start/end, rtl/ltr via lightningcss).
